svg.title: FOVI-Dex: language-conditioned active visuotactile policy
svg.desc: A single warped Cartesian camera view is encoded by frozen fovi*-DINOv3-S+. Masked vision-language attention returns a learned classification token and spatial tokens. Their projected concatenation joins proprioception and tactile features before shared recurrent control. A separate privileged recurrent critic estimates state value; rewards and values yield GAE advantages for asymmetric actor-critic PPO. Gaze actions use visual target distillation. All diagram text and shapes are editable; the actual camera observation is embedded as a PNG.
